items.titulo: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.resumen: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

items.titulo: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
items.resumen: Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%. The post Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano
items.resumen: Sakana AI released Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B-A3B reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano. It averages 60.1 across 25 benchmarks, ahead of the 120B Nemotron 3 Super at 56.2. The post Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano appeared first on MarkTechPost .

I open my email inbox, and I find pitches and articles from ostensibly serious people with ostensibly serious credentials attached to ostensibly serious institutions who want to publish things attached to their reputations and mine, and I see Claude . — Jack Despain Zhou , Spitting in the Face of Glaude Tags: ai-mis
